coverage_note: One qualifying design-level analysis: the BAMA high-dimensional mediation model (formal directed hypothesis, mediation). Boundary items cover the SAIGE GWAS association, the univariate mediation comparison sharing the same design unit, proposed future interventions, and cited external SNP associations.

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Association screen that generates the SNP exposures for the mediation model. It reports significant associations only, with no named identifying variation or formal directed method, so it is association, not a design-level causal analysis.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: GWAS with SAIGE identifying SNPs significantly associated with SPARE-AD index

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Same identifying variation (mediation), same SNP exposures, same UKBB population, and same normalized SNP-to-PA-to-SPARE-AD link as the BAMA analysis, applied as a comparison estimator returning null results. Not a distinct design unit from the qualifying mediation analysis.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Univariate mediation analysis (R mediation package) of BAMA-detected signals

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: External study findings quoted in the discussion to contextualize the three SNPs; not empirical results generated by this report.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Cited external GWAS associations linking identified SNPs to cognition, white blood cell count, and white matter

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Suggested future intervention design with no current-report empirical result; planned experiment only.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Proposed future interventional studies enhancing physical activity to reduce AD risk

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Bayesian high-dimensional mediation (BAMA) of physical activity patterns between SPARE-AD-associated SNPs and AD-like brain atrophy
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: UK Biobank cohort of 13,425 participants with imputed genetic data, wrist accelerometry, and structural MRI-derived SPARE-AD
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Named mediation (formal directed hypothesis) integrating genetics, accelerometry, and neuroimaging into one cross-omics directed model; outcome is age-related disease (AD) brain atrophy. Single design unit spanning all 22 SNP exposures under one shared analytic procedure; child SNP/mediator contrasts not split.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Implicit per-allele contrast (effect vs reference allele dosage); comparator wording incomplete in the mediation design
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: 22 SNPs significantly associated with SPARE-AD (mostly on AMPD3 gene) used as exposures
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Formal directed mediation model (BAMA) with assumed directional/temporal ordering SNP exposure to physical activity mediator to SPARE-AD outcome, using Bayesian continuous shrinkage prior and PIP-based active-mediator selection
outcome_constructs: Physical activity patterns (154 accelerometry features) as mediators
